title: Sauce de tasba à la viande (Tasba Leaf Sauce with Meat)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: Dried tasba leaves boiled with the meat 15 minutes, then peanut paste, salt and dalang added and simmered 20–30 minutes; the peanut paste can be replaced up to 50% with soaked soy paste.
longDesc: p. 67 of the October 2023 recipe book. The dried tasba leaves are boiled with the meat 15 minutes; roasted peanut paste, salt and dalang are added and cooked 20–30 minutes. The book’s tips: natron softens the leaves and keeps them green; the peanut paste can be replaced up to 50% with soaked soy paste. No quantities are printed.
ingredients: Dried tasba leaves — quantity not printed
Roasted peanut paste — quantity not printed
Water, oil, onion, garlic, ginger, salt, chilli, dalang — quantities not printed
steps: Boil the leaves with the meat for 15 minutes.
Add the peanut paste, salt and dalang.
chefTips: The book’s tip: natron softens the leaves and keeps them green.
Up to 50% of the peanut paste can be replaced with soaked soy paste.
commonMistakes: Skipping the natron when using dry leaves.
Not tasting for salt after the dalang.
healthBenefits: Dried leaves with peanuts and meat.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Sauce de tasba à la viande’ (p. 67).
